_comment: Sample project rule override. Copy to your repo root as .ocr/rule.json. The config shape mirrors open-code-review (ocr, Apache-2.0); see the repository NOTICE. Glob patterns map to extra checklist text the reviewer applies to matching files. merge=true prepends the built-in default rubric; merge=false replaces it.

rules.checklist: Frontend specifics: flag unhandled promise rejections, missing input validation on user-facing handlers, and direct DOM injection that could enable XSS.
Go specifics: flag unchecked errors, goroutine leaks, missing context cancellation, and data races on shared state.
Data layer: flag destructive migrations without a guard, missing indexes on new foreign keys, and SQL built via string concatenation.
